## Flagship Projects
- [SVVV Notes](https://svvv-notes.onrender.com/): A centralized student academic notes and resource-sharing platform with 9,775+ downloads, 1,390+ unique student sessions, and 210+ curated materials. Built with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, EJS, and Cloudinary. (GitHub: https://github.com/yshjain19/SVVV_Notes)
- [PrestigeStay](https://prestigestay.onrender.com/): Full-stack vacation rental and accommodation platform inspired by Airbnb featuring listings, reviews, user authentication, and Cloudinary media management. Built with Node.js, Express, MongoDB. (GitHub: https://github.com/yshjain19/Airbnb)
- [Kisan Mitra AI](https://kisanmitraai-d626.onrender.com/): Agricultural advisory and market price application assisting farmers with real-time insights and chat advisory. Built with Node.js and AI integration. (GitHub: https://github.com/yshjain19/kisanmitra-ai)
